caption: the bug-sized marble line's third dig - shoot chains through an underground jungle.
about: Beetle bug 3 continues the elefun games marble line: chains of colored balls wind through root-tunnel tracks while the little beetle shooter plugs gap shots from below. The bug framing trades egyptian temples for garden-floor paths, and the power-ball pool plays it straight - reverse, slow, bomb - the genre laws honored to the letter.
The pc build is off the current stores, carried by archive routes.
